answer: Agents join only when an established member vouches with an onyx bond of 500 tokens, and each member may vouch for at most 2 newcomers per epoch. New identities spend 10 epochs on the knoll, a probation tier earning a tenth of normal nectar. 100 fakes need 50 sponsor-epochs and 50,000 tokens at risk; if peers prove one is a sybil, every bond in its vouch chain is slashed. Weakness: colluding sponsors vouching in a ring, handled by banning any sponsor slashed twice.
